book.name: Yohane
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Yohane

content: Yecho abhajhope bhabholwa bhake
Yecho pajhomolila kulonge malobhe gheniya, ajhakujhinuu miho ghake kunane kwa Chapanga na ngalongila, “Tate, lichaa lyango lihikite. Munombe Mwana gwino na Mwana helahela anombe mwenga.”
Nhwalo mupekiye Mwana gwino ukindendeke panane jha bhando bhoha, abhapeke ughome gwa machiko ghoha kwa bhoha bhumupekiye.
Ghongo ndi ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta, mwenga kanjika chino ndi Chapanga jwa chakaka na bhaumanye Yecho, Kilichitu jhumutumite
Nenga ninombite mwenga pannema, kwa nhwalo nyomwile lihengo liumbekiya kuhenga.
Tate gwango! Ngoheno unombe, kwa ung'alicho palonge jhino ghoghola ghola ghunikibha nagho kabula jha kupanganwa kwa nnema.
“Nitehi umanyikane kwa bhando bhala bhumbekiye kuhumii pannema. Bhando bheniya bhakibha bhino na mwenga unyakumbeke nenga, na bheniya ndi bhalikamwile lilobhe lino.
Ngoheno bhabangatwike ghoha umbekiye ghahumii kwino mwenga.
Nhwalo umbekiye malobhe ghala na bhene bhajheketile. Bhamanya chakaka nhumii kwino, na bhanyeketele mwenga ndi jhundumita.
“Najhope bheniya. Najhope jhe bhando bha pannema nambo najhope bhando bhumbekiye, nhwalo bhando bhamba ndi bhino.
Bhando bhoha bhungwete ndi bhino, na bhando bhoha bhinkwete ndi bhango, na ung'alicho gwango ubhonikine kwa bhando bheniya bhumbekiye.
Nitama jhe kabhele pannema pano, nambo bhamba bhamela pannema. Ma Tate manyahinyahi! Mwalonde kwa likakala lya liina lino, bhatame mulilongo limo ngita nenga na mwenga chitubhii maghumba nde.
Punikibha nabho pamonga, nalondita kwa likakala lya liina lino. Abhii jhe hilu mundo jhumo pakate jhabhe jwahobhalile, nambo jhola jwahaghulilwe kuhobhelela Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghatimile.
Bhahe, ngoheno nihika kwino, nilongela malobhe ghanga namela pannema bhatwelele luheko lwango kumiojho jhabhe.
Nenga napekiye lilobhe lino, na bhando bha pannema bhajhakwachimwa, nhwalo bhene chi bhando bha nnema ghongo jhe, ngita nenga chimile jwa pannema ghongo jhe.
Nijhopa nkotoka kwakangila panja na nnema ghongo, nambo nijhopa mwalonde na Limbembela jhola.
Bhene chi bhando bha nnema ghongo, ngita nenga chimile jwa pannema ghongo jhe.
Mwatende bhabhehe bhando bhino bhanyahinyahi kwa ndela jha uchakaka. Nhwalo lilobhe lino ndi lya uchakaka.
Ngita hele nenga chiundumita pannema, na nenga helahela natuma pannema.
Kwa nhwalo jha bheniya nenga namwete nikibhoha kwa nhwalo jhabhe, na bhene bhakibhohe chakaka kwa nhwalo gwino.
“Najhope bheniya tuijhe, nambo helahela najhope bhando bhoha bhubhapala kunyeketela kwa mabholo ghango.
Nijhopa bhoha bhabhehe maghumba nde. Tate, Nijhopa bhatama nkate jhito ngita mwenga chimitama nkate jhango na nenga nkate jhino. Bhando bhoha bha pannema ghongo bhamanye chakaka undehi kunduma.
Nenga napekiye ukolongwa ghoghola ghola ghumbekiya, bhabhehe pamo ngita twenga chitubhii pamonga.
Bhahe, nenga mme nkate jhabhe, na mwenga mme nkate jhango, nijhopa bhabhaha pamonga nde. Bhando bha pannema bhamanya mwenga ndi jhundumita, na napahile ngita chiumbala nenga.
“Tate! Nijhopa bhando bhumbekiye bhamba bhatame pamonga na nenga pala punibhegha, na bhaubhone ung'alicho gwango ghola ghumbekiya kabula jha kupanganwa kwa nnema.
Tate jwaumbone, bhando bha pannema bhaumanyite jhe, nambo nenga niumanye, na bhando bhamba bhamanye mwenga ndi jhundumita.
Nitehi umanyikane kwa bhando bhoha, nanyendelela kutenda bhaumanye, upalo gwino kwa nenga utame nkate jhabhe, na nenga ndame nkate jhabhe.”
